title: Credential comparison: == versus equals
answer: Using == for credential strings can reject equal text stored in different String objects, creating incorrect authentication behavior even when the characters match exactly. For security-sensitive secrets, a dedicated constant-time comparison may also be appropriate; == is still the wrong content test.
